1. SETUP
Choose receiving surfaces in Modify. Add layers in the order they should calculate.

2. ASSETS
Choose models for each paint set, or place model pivots inside a source rectangle. Move outside to park a model without losing its settings.

3. POPULATION
Set the layer count or density. Enabled paint-set weights share that population. Accepted target retries within explicit limits.

4. PAINT
Enable coverage, then paint on the receiving surface. Area limits apply to all sets in this layer. Use earlier sets as explicit background references.

5. TRANSFORM + SPACING
Layer transforms apply to every set. Set self-spacing, between-set rules and layer pairs separately. Earlier owners occupy space first.

6. UPDATE + INSPECT
Manual keeps the last completed result until Update. Live publishes after edits. Hidden owners still calculate; disabled owners do not. Counts here describe cached results, not an estimate of available room.

The editor stays on this Scatter when scene selection changes. Use the Layer and Paint set selectors to change ownership. Hover buttons and numeric fields for short explanations.
